about_the_game:
Disposable Corps is a fun, low-poly, team-based PvP first-person shooting game. Set against a WW1 trench warfare backdrop, the game introduces a unique twist as a turn-based tower defense experience, where players alternate between offensive and defensive roles.

What to expect in the Demo

In the Disposable Corps demo, you’ll jump into a fast-paced mix of first-person shooting and strategic tower defense, set during WW1 trench warfare. Play one multiplayer map where teams take turns attacking and defending key flag points. Build fortifications like sandbags, barbed wire, and machine gun posts to hold your ground, or launch an all-out assault to capture enemy positions. Earn in-game currency by advancing on enemy flags and use it to strengthen your defenses for the next round. Coordinate with your team, outsmart your opponents, and get a first taste of Disposable Corps' tactical multiplayer action.

content_descriptors.notes: This game depicts realistic trench warfare with intense and graphic violence, including blood, gore, and dismemberment. Players will experience large-scale battles, close-quarters combat, and artillery bombardments, all presented with a high level of realism. While there is no sexual content, the game includes mature war themes such as battlefield injuries, historical weaponry, and intense combat scenarios.
